name: foundry
description: foundry — Ethereum development toolkit. Includes forge (build/test), cast (interact), anvil (local node).

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry/releases/latest/download/foundry_nightly_linux_amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf foundry_nightly_linux_amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv forge cast anvil /usr/local/bin/ && rm foundry_nightly_linux_amd64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
